teams.heading: Steve Hansen says Mark Nawaqanitawase could be better off playing for Fiji
teams.body: Former All Blacks coach Sir Steve Hansen has said that Mark Nawaqanitawase, who is weighing up his Test options after returning to union with Japanese club Saitama Wild Knights, could be better off playing for Fiji. Hansen said he hopes the 26-year-old plays for Australia, but that if Japan commitments take priority, Nawaqanitawase probably won't be available much for the Wallabies anyway. He has 11 Australia caps and would also be eligible for Italy and Fiji.

teams.heading: Keith Prowse unveils England's 2027 Six Nations Twickenham hospitality packages
teams.body: Hospitality provider Keith Prowse has unveiled packages for England's three home Six Nations games in 2027, against France, Italy and Scotland at Twickenham. Options range from the Rose Garden, with its rooftop terrace, live music and all-inclusive bar, to The Lock, a four-course menu developed in collaboration with chef Tom Kerridge. Ticket options for all three games have been confirmed, and the Allianz Suite offers grazing stations while guests hear from an international rugby legend.

teams.heading: Gavin Coombes omitted from Ireland XV's 28-man squad for Fiji 'A'
teams.body: Ireland XV have named a 28-man squad for the Cork match against Fiji 'A', and Gavin Coombes is not in it. Nine Munster players are included, among them former England prop Kieran Brookes, while Alex Kendellen and Shane Daly also miss out. Mark Sexton, who coaches the side, called it "a hugely important fixture for players to put their hands up and try to break into the senior Men's squad." Gus McCarthy captains the group.

teams.heading: Quesada reveals 17 unavailable Italy players as captaincy call nears
teams.body: Italy head into the November window with 17 players unavailable, Gonzalo Quesada said at the launch of the Northern Phase, and he will decide on the captaincy next week. He is monitoring 67 players of national interest, and Giacomo Nicotera and Niccolò Cannone have both captained before. The run is four consecutive matches against top-ten opponents: South Africa in Turin, Argentina in Genoa and Fiji in Udine, before the final phase in London. The captaincy call will depend on who is actually available.

teams.heading: Wales wing Ellis Mee signs new Scarlets contract, length of deal undisclosed
teams.body: Wales wing Ellis Mee has signed a new contract with Scarlets, though the length of the deal has not been disclosed. The 23-year-old has made 43 appearances for the Parc y Scarlets club since joining from Nottingham in 2024, scoring 11 tries, and has 11 Test appearances for Wales since his debut against Ireland in the 2025 Six Nations. Mee's form has also earned him a place in Steve Tandy's squad for the upcoming Nations Championship games. "I am delighted to have re-signed with the Scarlets," he said.

teams.heading: Galindo names Bernasconi-led 27-man Argentina XV to face England A
teams.body: Argentina's coach Álvaro Galindo has named a 27-man Argentina XV to play England A in Bath in an uncapped match, with Benetton hooker Bernardo Bernasconi, who has three caps, heading the squad. The match gives players from both sides a chance at call-ups to the test arena. The squad includes Harlequins prop Pedro Delgado, Bristol Bears flanker Benjamín Grondona and Clermont fly-half Juan Segundo Martín Montilla, who is 19. The squad trained for four days at Hindú Club in Buenos Aires.

teams.heading: Tom Hooper cleared of major injury after shoulder blow, Les Kiss confirms
teams.body: Back-rower Tom Hooper has been cleared of any major injury concerns, with Les Kiss confirming that all scans came back clear after he was taken off early for Exeter last week with a shoulder injury. A repeat of the scapula fracture he suffered in the July Tests had been feared, but Kiss said, ‘it’s just sore but all scans have cleared everything.’ Carter Gordon and Ben Donaldson, who both missed the Bledisloe Cup Test in Sydney, are also likely to be available.

teams.heading: Japan sit 10th of 12 after three Nations Championship matches
teams.body: Japan have won one of their three Nations Championship matches so far, which leaves them 10th of 12 in the log. Across those three games they have scored 62 points and conceded 88, a points difference of -26. Their most recent match was a 28-34 defeat to Fiji. Next for Japan is Round 4 against Wales.

teams.heading: Saula Ma'u picked after Tyrel Lomax ruled out with neck issue
teams.body: Saula Ma'u was picked for the 36-man squad after Tyrel Lomax was ruled out with a neck issue. Sir John Kirwan, on the Rivals podcast, wants more size up front against South Africa, pointing to Ma'u and Pasilio Tosi, both around 22st. "I'm hoping they're going to get some opportunities to play and start Test matches up north because I do think we need their size." Ma'u has yet to earn a cap but is expected to make his Test debut next month.

lead.why: It is the strongest new item in the pack, and it turns on a concrete selection event: Ma'u's inclusion after Lomax's injury.

teams.heading: Rassie Erasmus posts cryptic X message wondering if 'they really sleep well'
teams.body: Rassie Erasmus posted a cryptic message on X on Friday, and it gives little away. He wrote that he wondered 'if they really sleep well' tonight. He also wrote, 'The saddest is everyone know this was going to happen.' The post names no target and no event, and it sits alongside a message about how proud he is to be South African. Erasmus' 37-man squad for the November leg of the Nations Championship has already been picked.
